title: Copilot Agent Configuration
description: Defines Copilot agents and their associated components for an SPFx solution.

components.description: Component manifest GUIDs that this agent exposes as MCP tools.

toolDiscovery.description: How the generated ai-plugin.json advertises this agent's tools. 'dynamic' enables MCP Dynamic Tool Discovery: the generated manifest carries no tool catalog (empty functions, run_for_functions ['*'], no mcp_tool_description) so Copilot resolves tools from the SharePoint MCP server at runtime and picks up added/changed tools without republishing. 'static' pins a fixed tool catalog into functions + runtimes[].spec.mcp_tool_description; changing a tool requires republishing the agent. Static is the temporary default until the server-side dynamic discovery issue is fixed.
